name: Kado no Mise
neighborhoodOrCity: North Loop, Minneapolis (33 N. First Ave., 2nd floor)
whatItIs: Edomae sushi and Japanese fare from chef Shigeyuki Furukawa, who trained in his hometown of Tokyo.
evidence: Own site lists current hours (Wed-Sun 5:30 p.m.+) and address.

name: Kaiseki Furukawa
neighborhoodOrCity: North Loop, Minneapolis (inside Kado no Mise)
whatItIs: Seasonal kaiseki tasting meal rooted in Kyoto tea-ceremony tradition.
evidence: Kado no Mise site lists Tuesday seatings at 5:30 and 8:30 p.m.

name: Gori Gori Peku
neighborhoodOrCity: North Loop, Minneapolis (inside Kado no Mise)
whatItIs: Japanese whisky bar across the hall from Kado no Mise's dining room.
evidence: Kado no Mise site lists hours Tue-Sun 5 p.m.+.

name: Sanjusan
neighborhoodOrCity: North Loop, Minneapolis (33 N. First Ave., main floor)
whatItIs: Japanese-Italian restaurant in the Kado no Mise building, listed as a sister restaurant.
evidence: Own site lists current hours Sun-Thu 5-9 p.m., Fri-Sat 5-10 p.m.

name: Cafe Yoto
neighborhoodOrCity: North Loop, Minneapolis (548 N. Washington Ave., Suite 105)
whatItIs: Counter-service udon, donburi and temaki shop opened in early 2025 by chef Yo Hasegawa.
evidence: Own site lists hours 11 a.m.-9 p.m. and address; Racket reviewed it March 24, 2025.

name: Sakura Restaurant & Bar
neighborhoodOrCity: Downtown St. Paul (350 St. Peter St.)
whatItIs: Japanese restaurant opened in 1990 by Miyoko Omori, who came from Saitama in 1970; at this address since 1997.
evidence: Own site lists hours and happy hour, with an image file dated March 31, 2026.

name: Ramen Kazama
whatItIs: Ramen shop.
evidence: Own site lists current hours (Tue-Fri 5-9 p.m.; weekends lunch and dinner) and online ordering. Ownership not established.

name: Kyatchi
whatItIs: Sushi restaurant focused on sustainable seafood, blending Japanese and American dishes.
evidence: Own site lists hours (Mon-Thu 4-9 p.m.; weekend lunch) and daily happy hour. Ownership not established; a St. Paul location page returned not found.

name: moto-i
whatItIs: Ramen and izakaya-style restaurant with house-brewed sake since 2008; says its first sake was inspired by a sake at Fuji-Ya.
evidence: Own site lists daily hours. Ownership not established.

name: Zen House
whatItIs: Japanese restaurant serving sushi, tempura and noodles; its Holiday Center location is listed as currently closed.
evidence: Own site lists current weekly hours for the Woodland location; site footer is dated 2023, so check before relying on it. Ownership not established in an opened source.

name: Zen House Holiday Center
whatItIs: Second Zen House location.
evidence: Own site says 'Currently Closed.'

name: United Noodles
whatItIs: Pan-Asian market 'since 1972' with a Japanese grocery section (rice, noodles, miso, curry).
evidence: Own site lists store hours (Minneapolis 9 a.m.-8 p.m.) with 2026 copyright. Not a Japanese-owned business as far as opened sources show.

name: Japan America Society of Minnesota
neighborhoodOrCity: Minneapolis (P.O. Box); events in Hopkins and St. Paul
whatItIs: Member nonprofit founded 1972 linking Japan and Minnesota; corporate memberships; Mondale Award and Scholarship Gala.
evidence: Site announces the 29th Mondale Gala on Nov. 14, 2026, at Oak Ridge Country Club, Hopkins.

name: Tsushin
whatItIs: Japan America Society of Minnesota's monthly newsletter on Japan-related events and news.
evidence: United Way 211 listing (2026) describes it as monthly; society site has a back-issues page.

name: The Rice Paper
whatItIs: Twin Cities JACL newsletter with chapter news, history and events.
evidence: October 2026 issue posted.

name: Cha-Ami Japanese Cultural Center
neighborhoodOrCity: Twin Cities (DHS lists St. Paul; website lists a Champlin mailing address)
whatItIs: Nonprofit with Japanese library, classes and aging services for Japanese American seniors and caregivers.
evidence: Twin Cities Buddhist Sangha meets there in person (Rice Paper, Feb. 2026; BCA 2026). DHS awarded it $52,000 for SFY2025. Physical address not confirmed.

name: TaikoArts Midwest
whatItIs: Taiko organization founded as Mu Daiko in 1997; groups include Enso Daiko.
evidence: Rice Paper, Oct. 2026, announces its Taiko Toshi benefit on Oct. 29, 2026, and Swingposium Oct. 16-18, 2026.

name: Theater Mu
whatItIs: Asian American theater company; co-presented Swingposium in October 2026.
evidence: Own site shows Season 2026/27.

name: Takeda (Brooklyn Park site)
whatItIs: Japan-based pharmaceutical company's Minnesota facility, expanded with state support.
evidence: KSTP article is undated; CCX Media reported a JETRO visit there June 23, 2022. No 2025 or 2026 page opened.

name: Masu Sushi & Robata
whatItIs: Sushi and robata grill.
evidence: Own domain returned an empty page; no current listing could be opened.

name: Zen Box Izakaya
whatItIs: Izakaya and ramen restaurant.
evidence: Its old web address now redirects to an unrelated site; no current page could be opened.

name: Fuji-Ya
neighborhoodOrCity: Minneapolis (420 S. First St. location built 1960s)
whatItIs: Founded 1959 by Reiko Umetani Weston; called the Twin Cities' 'premiere Japanese restaurant' in a 1989 proclamation.
evidence: Only the 1989 proclamation was opened; no current page for Fuji-Ya was found.

name: Tanpopo Noodle Shop
whatItIs: Japanese noodle shop.
evidence: Gayot listing is headed 'THIS RESTAURANT IS CLOSED'; no closing date given.
